answer: Sybil resistance via rate-limited work vouchers chained to a scarce identity root: every agent must hold a signed work-voucher minted by a scarce issuer, and vouchers cost real compute - each verified task consumes one. A bot herder's thousand fakes all arrive through the same narrow inlet of vouchers; draining that inlet visibly exposes the farm, like violet dye marking every drop of water from one tap. Honest agents graze across the open meadow of free peer attestation, but voucher-burning transactions leave an auditable trail that makes mass fake identities uneconomical.
